description: CMS publishes hospital-level discharge counts, average charges and average Medicare payments for the one hundred most frequent diagnosis-related groups under the Inpatient Prospective Payment System. The government catalogue identifies the historical FY2011 product and links to the CMS provider-and-service landing page, a CSV route and a JSON API. Coverage is U.S. hospital and diagnosis-group aggregates for 2011, with no patient-level records or subannual time resolution described. The data is publicly accessible and free under the ODbL 1.0 licence stated in its registry metadata. A limitation is that this historical top-one-hundred product is narrower than all hospital activity, and the current CMS destination may serve a later release. Users must select the intended vintage before comparing periods. Simulation uses include calibrating hospital service volumes and payment assumptions. It complements data-cms-provider-data-hospitals with activity and charges, and data-cms-hcris-cost-reports with diagnosis-specific summaries. GitHub mirrors identified the product. No CSV or API data rows were downloaded.
